high_level_description: The image depicts a person performing a yoga pose outdoors. The individual is wearing a long-sleeved, patterned dress with a green base color and intricate gold designs. The dress has a flowing, elegant appearance, complementing the graceful movement of the pose. The person's hair is long and dark, cascading down their back as they bend forward. They are reaching towards the ground with one arm extended, while the other arm is bent at the elbow, supporting their body weight. The pose suggests flexibility and balance, indicative of a yoga practice.
